text: 1. Mission This major is a critical branch among all art related categories. It plays an important role in cultural and spiritual life. This major offers two academic programs -- painting and sculpture, including Chinese painting, oil painting, engraving, sculpture, art theory, and sketch. Students are to be exposed to complete range of fine art theories and practices, in order to develop advanced knowledge and skills in art education and art practices. 2. Duration 3 years 3. The dissertation and the works 1. Once finishing the required credits, students can apply to start dissertation research. Before submitting the dissertation outline, students are required to finish 2 or 3 relevant reports on design topics. 2. The report on the degree works and the dissertation proposal are expected to be completed by the 3rd semester of the 2nd year. The topic of dissertation should combine both the fundamental knowledge related to the major and the new theoretical and technological issues of art design at home and abroad. The outline should include the goal, the methodology, the schedule, and the methods of displaying, with no less than 2,000 characters. 3. The content of degree works and dissertation proposal should be reviewed and supervised by 3 professors or more. 4. During the dissertation and degree works, two phases of reviews will be arranged so as to have more suggestions from the faculty and make sure the dissertation is on schedule. 5. Once approved by 5 professors including the tutor, the oral defense of the dissertation could then be preceded. All of the works will be exhibited publicly.
